thread:
lee: Heads-up proposal: make SDKs stop auto-falling back to tenant default route when `route-preference` is missing. Instead return a 409-like deterministic routing error and surface a migration path.

anika: Why 409-ish? Curious about UX for customers who rely on graceful fallback for availability.

lee: Two reasons: 1) current silent fallback mixes tenant metrics in the console and breaks per-route quota. 2) we can't clearly bill or enforce QoS if route is inferred. Returning an explicit error forces teams to fix upstream code.

rahul: Could we provide two intermediates: 
- agent-mode: SDK logs + telemetry but still fallback (default for 2 releases)
- strict-mode: SDK rejects w/ error and emits `route_migration_needed` event
That gives operators time to opt apps into strict-mode.

lee: I like agent-mode. Proposed timeline:
- release A (minor): add `route_mode` param: `auto|agent|strict`. default `auto` keeps current behavior but emits a warning telemetry tag `route_legacy_seen`.
- release B (minor, ~6w later): change default to `agent`. `agent` keeps fallback but assigns traffic to a tenant-scoped `legacy-route` bucket so console shows correct attribution.
- release C (minor): change default to `strict` and surface strong WARN + link to migration.
- release D (major): remove `auto` and `agent` after deprecation window.

tess: Console changes: we need a per-tenant bar showing "legacy-route %" and an exportable CSV of top callers. Also plan a tenant-level toggle to enable the legacy-bucket mapping so we can give exceptions.

rahul: For TS SDK: my concern is churn from forcing a major. Doing the staged plan lets us keep semver-minor steps. We'll add the new param with a deprecation warning string pointing to docs.

lee: Go SDK: watch out for header mutators in http.RoundTripper chains. We must ensure our shim runs before any retry/timeout wrapper, otherwise a request may be retried with wrong headers. Add an integration test that injects a flaky transport to catch ordering.

anika: Telemetry: emit `route_mode` tag and `legacy_route_bucket` boolean. Console will sample first 10k requests after each SDK rollout to create a migration heatmap.

tess: Messaging: We'll surface a console modal when a tenant has >2% legacy-route usage for 7 days. Modal links to quick PR templates for Python/TS/Go. Also email owners 7 days before default flips.

lee: Sample Python snippet for quick fix:
```python
# quick patch: explicitly set route pref
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), route_mode='strict')
```

anika: For clusters where code change is hard, support will document a per-deployment env `REDWOOD_ROUTE_LEGACY_BUCKET=true` that flips on a tenant feature flag server-side. Only ops should use it.

rahul: CI changes: add unit+integration for TS and Go ensuring `route_mode` values round-trip and telemetry tags appear. Also add e2e smoke that asserts console attribution when `agent` is on.

ci-bot: CI job queued: devex/route-mode-tests -> build 12 running.

lee: Docs checklist: migration guide, changelog note, k8s patch example, console FAQ, sample PR templates. Also include a script for teams to scan codebase for `X-Route` header writes.

tess: I'll make the console tile and modal mocks, will post links once done.

anika: We should add a small billing note reminding tenants that legacy bucket attribution may change dollar numbers; legal OK? I'll loop in billing.

lee: Action items:
- rahul: implement param + telemetry for TS/Go. add tests for RoundTripper ordering.
- tess: console tile + modal mocks + tenant toggle backend feature.
- anika: migration docs + billing check.
- lee: publish RFC + coordinate canary list.

ci-bot: build 12 passed for ts-sdk; go-sdk build started.

rahul: pushed PR for ts-sdk: https://git.redwood/s/ts-sdk/pulls/922 (WIP)

lee: Thanks everyone. Please report any weird error patterns in this thread.
